about: What a motion gate verdict was measured on (docs/PEOPLE_MOTION.md §1.9). 'people': everything that decides how the game's people look and move; 'measures': the gate's own measures and limits. Each is hashed (SHA-256 over each file's path and the SHA-256 of its bytes, in path order) by HumanMotionGateTests when it writes docs/qa/gates/motion_gate.json, and again by tools/qa/people_gate.mjs: a verdict whose hashes are not the tree's is stale and counts as red. A '*' matches within one path segment. Add a file here when it starts to decide how people look or move; never take one out to make a verdict fresh.
